aboutMe.question: Who am I?
aboutMe.description: Always passionated by web development and software development in general. I like videogames, synthwave music & all the computer/technology stuff that most of us in this business like :P
aboutMe.biographyIntro: I currently consider myself to be in a mid level of Software Developer, most focused in backend side, but also worked in frontend tasks. At the end, my main goal is to become a full stack dev!
aboutMe.biographyLearning: If there is something that school teached me well, it's the ability to learn whatever it takes in order to do the best possible job and deliver the best possible code/product. That's why, if I don't know a technology, you can be sure that I can learn it if the job requires it.

Built AI-assisted Node.js/Express tools that automated AppSec requests and ServiceNow tickets (+33% productivity)

Made the Wire Payment File Upload asynchronous, removing 1+ minute timeouts
Diagnosed critical production issues across Kafka, Redis and GCP
Upgraded microservices and shared Java libraries to newer Spring Boot and JDK versions
Supported 10+ production releases and onboarded new developers
